newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish higher amid shortcovering.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish higher amid shortcovering.

text.p: April 28 - U.S. debt futures finished higher, with June T-bonds near the day's 107-14/32 high. Traders cite Fed coupon pass, say shortcovering developed after that. Activity quiet overall, volume picked up slightly late, traders said. Market awaits Q1 ECI and latest durable goods on Tuesday. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
